nodes.label: graphify add URL Ingest
nodes.rationale: Fetches a URL into ./raw with optional author/contributor tags, auto-detecting YouTube (audio via yt-dlp for later transcription), Twitter/X via oEmbed, arXiv abstracts, PDFs, images, and generic webpages converted to markdown. A successful save automatically runs the --update pipeline; errors must be reported rather than silently swallowed.

nodes.label: --watch Folder Watcher
nodes.rationale: Code changes trigger an immediate AST re-extract, rebuild, and re-cluster with no LLM; doc/paper/image changes only write a needs_update flag because they require semantic re-extraction. The debounce waits for file activity to stop so a wave of parallel agent writes does not trigger one rebuild per file.

edges.source_location: re-runs AST extraction + rebuild + cluster immediately
YouTube / any video URL → audio downloaded, transcribed on next run
